3. Data Protection & Resilience!sheet3_t.s3_t1_notes: All employees and contractors undergo regular security awareness training appropriate to their role and function within the organization upon hire and annually.

All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 (see id=23.2, id=7.1). The platform manages encryption keys on behalf of the customer, though customers may elect to manage their own keys via KMS integration (see id=23.5).
